max_fee_cap.meaning: DynamicSwapFeeModule.MAX_FEE_CAP, the maximum dynamic swap fee in hundredths of a percent (500,000 = 50%)

dynamic_fee.meaning: dynamically calculated swap fee value in the same hundredths-of-a-percent scale as MAX_FEE_CAP

fee_accepted_by_get_swap_fee.meaning: CLFactory.getSwapFee() accepts (does not reject) the dynamically calculated fee

anti_mev_cap_unusable.meaning: the 50% anti-MEV protection cap becomes unusable

assumptions: dynamic_fee and max_fee_cap share the same hundredths-of-a-percent scale as stated by the report's 500,000 = 50% equivalence.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the concrete dynamic fee value or the exact rejection mechanism by which CLFactory.getSwapFee() rejects fees, so the direct contradiction between V (cap unusable) and I (fees up to cap accepted) cannot be mechanically derived; V is encoded as the report's stated outcome.

limitations: V is the report's stated outcome 'the 50% anti-MEV protection cap becomes unusable'; the report does not give a numeric fee value or explicit rejection predicate linking it to I, so the P AND V AND I contradiction is left to the post-generation audit.
